transcript.en: Hello, South City Cycling Club.
transcript.zh: 你好，南城自行车俱乐部。

transcript.en: Oh, hi. umm... I want to find out about joining the club.
transcript.zh: 你好，我想咨询加入俱乐部的事情。

transcript.en: Right. I can help you there.
transcript.zh: 好的，我可以帮助你。

transcript.en: I’m the club secretary and my name’s Jim Hunter.
transcript.zh: 我是俱乐部的秘书，我叫吉姆·亨特。

transcript.en: Oh, hi Jim.
transcript.zh: 你好，吉姆。

transcript.en: So, are you interested in membership for yourself?
transcript.zh: 所以，你对自己的会员资格感兴趣是吗？

transcript.en: That’s right
transcript.zh: 嗯嗯，是的。

transcript.en: OK. Well there are basically two types of adult membership.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们这总体而言就有两种成人会员。

transcript.en: If you’re pretty serious about cycling, there’s the Full membership.
transcript.zh: 如果你真的很热爱自行车骑行，我们这有正式会员资格。

transcript.en: That costs 260 dollars and that covers you not just for ordinary cycling
transcript.zh: 这会花费260美元，不仅包括了普通自行车的比赛，

transcript.en: but also for races both here in the city and also in other parts of Australia.
transcript.zh: 同样也包括了本市和澳大利亚其他地区的比赛

transcript.en: Right. Well, I’m not really up to that standard.
transcript.zh: 哦，好的。但是我还没达到那水准。

transcript.en: I was more interested in just joining a group to do some cycling in my free time.
transcript.zh: 我对那种业余骑行更感兴趣。

transcript.en: Sure. That’s why most people join.
transcript.zh: 是的，这就是为什么大多数人加入的原因。

transcript.en: So, in that case you’d be better with the Recreational membership.
transcript.zh: 所以在这种情况之下，你最好还是加入娱乐小组。

transcript.en: That’s 108 dollars if you're over 19, and 95 dollars if you’re under.
transcript.zh: 如果你超过了19岁，费用就是108刀，如果小于18岁，就是95刀。
我今年25岁了。

transcript.en: OK. It’s paid quarterly, and you can upgrade it later to the Full membership if you want to of course.
transcript.zh: 好的，这是按季度付的，当然日后你改变想法了的话也可以升级为正式会员。

transcript.en: Now both types of membership include the club fee of 20 dollars,
transcript.zh: 现在两种类型的会员都包括20美元的俱乐部加入费用，

transcript.en: they also provide insurance in case you have an accident, though we hope you won’t need that, of course.
transcript.zh: 他们还提供保险费用以免你出了意外，我们当然希望你用不上它。

transcript.en: No. OK, well, I’ll go with the Recreational membership, I think.
transcript.zh: 不了，我想好了，我还是选择娱乐会员吧。

transcript.en: And that allows me to join in the club activities, and so on?
transcript.zh: 这样我就可以参加俱乐部的活动了，是吧？

transcript.en: That’s right. And once you’re a member of the club,
transcript.zh: 是的，而且一旦你成为我们的会员，

transcript.en: you’re also permitted to wear our kit when you’re out cycling.
transcript.zh: 你外出骑行的时候就可以穿上我们的装备。

transcript.en: It’s green and white.
transcript.zh: 有绿色和白色相间的。

transcript.en: Yes, I’ve seen cyclists wearing it. So, can I buy that at the club?
transcript.zh: 是的，我曾经看过骑行的人穿过它，我可以在俱乐部买吗？

transcript.en: No. it’s made to order by a company in Brisbane.
transcript.zh: 不行，衣服是由布里斯班的一家公司定做的。

transcript.en: You can find them online: they’re called Jerriz. That’s J-E-R-R-l-Z.
transcript.zh: 你可以在网上找到他们，叫杰里兹，即J-E-R-R-l-Z。

transcript.en: You can use your membership number to put in an order on their website.
transcript.zh: 你可以用你的会员号在他们的网站上下单。

transcript.en: OK. Now, can you tell me a bit about the rides I can do?
transcript.zh: 好的，现在你可以告诉我一些我可以做的骑行活动吗？

transcript.en: Sure. So we have training rides pretty well every morning,
transcript.zh: 好的，我们每天早上都有很棒的骑行训练，

transcript.en: and they’re a really good way of improving your cycling skills as well as your general level of fitness, but they’re different levels.
transcript.zh: 这可以很好地提高你的骑行技术同时也可以提高你的整体健康水平，但是训练有分很多种类型

transcript.en: Level A is pretty fast - you’re looking at about 30 or 35 kilometres an hour.
transcript.zh: A级是相当快的，在一个小时之内你要骑行30公里或35公里。

transcript.en: If you can do about 25 kilometres an hour, you’d probably be level B, and then level C are the novices,
transcript.zh: 如果一小时骑到25公里，那么你可能就是B级的，然后C级就是初级班，

transcript.en: who stay at about 15 kilometres per hour.
transcript.zh: 每小时骑行15公里。

transcript.en: Right Well I reckon I’d be level B.
transcript.zh: 好的，我估计我自己应该是B级吧。

transcript.en: So, when are the sessions for that level?
transcript.zh: 那么这个级别的课程什么时候开始呢？

transcript.en: There are a couple each week. They’re both early morning sessions.
transcript.zh: 每周都有几节课，而且都是开在早上的。

transcript.en: There’s one on Tuesdays, and for that one you meet at 5.30 am, and the meeting point’s the stadium -
transcript.zh: 周二有一节，集合时间是早上5：30分，地点是体育馆，

transcript.en: do you know where that is?
transcript.zh: 你知道那在哪里吗？

transcript.en: Yes, it’s quite near my home, in fact. OK, and how about the other one?
transcript.zh: 好的，那离我家很近，另外一节呢？

transcript.en: That’s on Thursdays. It starts at the same time, but they meet at the main gate to the park.
transcript.zh: 另外一节是在周四，开始地点一样，但是碰面地点改在了公园的大门。

transcript.en: Is that the one just past the shopping mall?
transcript.zh: 就是刚刚经过购物中心的那个吗？

transcript.en: That’s it.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: So how long are the rides?
transcript.zh: 那么乘车需要多长时间呢?

transcript.en: They’re about an hour and a half.
transcript.zh: 大约需要一个半小时。

transcript.en: So, if you have a job it’s easy to fit in before you go to work.
transcript.zh: 所以如果你有一份工作，你在去工作之前很容易抽出时间来这的。

transcript.en: And the members often go somewhere for coffee afterwards, so it’s quite a social event.
transcript.zh: 会员们事后会经常会去某个地方喝咖啡，所以这也算是一种社交活动。

transcript.en: OK. That sounds good. I’ve only just moved to the city so I don’t actually know many people yet.
transcript.zh: 哦，听起来不错。我才刚搬来这座城市，所以我还没有认识很多人。

transcript.en: Well, it’s a great way to meet people.
transcript.zh: 嗯，这是一种结交新朋友的好方式。

transcript.en: And does each ride have a leader?
transcript.zh: 每一次骑行都有一个领队吗？

transcript.en: Sometimes, but not always. But you don’t really need one;
transcript.zh: 有时，但并非总是如此，你并不需要。

transcript.en: the group members on the ride support one another, anyway.
transcript.zh: 因为在旅途上团队成员会互相帮助。

transcript.en: How would we know where to go?
transcript.zh: 我们怎么知道要去哪里？

transcript.en: If you check the club website, you’ll see that the route for each ride is clearly marked.
transcript.zh: 如果你查一下俱乐部的网站，你就会发现每一次骑行的路线都明确标记出来了。

transcript.en: So you can just print that out and take it along with you.
transcript.zh: 所以你可以把它打印出来，随身携带，

transcript.en: It’s similar from one week to another, but it’s not always exactly the same.
transcript.zh: 每一个星期的都很类似，但是并不完全相同。

transcript.en: And what do I need to bring?
transcript.zh: 我还需要带什么呢？

transcript.en: Well, bring a bottle of water, and your phone.
transcript.zh: 嗯，还有一瓶水和一部手机。

transcript.en: You shouldn’t use it while you’re cycling, but have it with you.
transcript.zh: 不是说你在骑行的过程当中要用它，而是说你要带上它。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: And in winter it’s well before sunrise when we set out,
transcript.zh: 冬天的时候，我们出发的时候太阳还没升起来，

transcript.en: so you need to make sure your bike’s got lights.
transcript.zh: 所以你要确保你的自行车上有灯光装置。

transcript.en: That’s OK. Well, thanks Jim. I’d definitely like to join.
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢你，吉姆。我肯定会加入的。

transcript.en: So what’s the best way of going about it?
transcript.zh: 那最好的方法是什么呢？

transcript.en: You can ...
transcript.zh: 你可以...
